comparison.objective: Remove only the top plate from a stack without disturbing lower plates; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-part singulation, controlled separation, and disturbance avoidance versus coaxial mandrel placement, bimanual hammering, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Top plate removed while lower plates remain undisturbed versus four tangs fractured and recovered with inserts and shell intact. The record has an empty body and no numeric disturbance rubric or specs.
comparison.reason: Selective destacking is meaningfully different from notch fracture and loose-fragment containment, notwithstanding missing thresholds.
